methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: novel process model examples, covering energy management policy, system design, implementation planning, and energy management audit-related process models

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents the iSEE:Green energy-management architecture/framework and qualitative process models (policy, system design, implementation planning, audit). EnPI/EnB content appears only incidentally as generic ISO 50001 elements ("establish a baseline and energy performance indicators") and an uncharacterised "energy flow transfer function"; no measurement model is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Matches the v2.3 ineligible clause for a framework without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.
stage1.notes: Framework/architecture paper; EnPI/EnB only as generic ISO 50001 list items. Large mercury/coal-pollution digression unrelated to energy modelling.
